name: South Africa
dossier:
The South Africa national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Bafana Bafana, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 60 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CAF to this expanded 48-team tournament.

An underdog with golden-generation flashes, dreaming of a first knockout appearance.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, South Africa will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group A and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group A. The connection between Lyle Foster and Percy Tau is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Lyle Foster - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: South Africa are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Bafana Bafana remain the only host nation to be eliminated in the group stage (2010)  -  they want to rewrite that story.
South Africa boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (host 2010).
